title: The Locked Study
briefing: The study was locked from the outside and only two people ever handled the key. The cook swears she never left her kitchen. Decide who took it.

atoms.L: The cook left the kitchen that evening
atoms.S: The key has a fresh scratch

statements.speaker: Housekeeper
statements.text: Only the butler and the cook can reach the key hook. One of them took it.

statements.speaker: Butler
statements.text: The hook is in the hall. If the cook took the key, she left the kitchen.

clues.text: The key has a fresh scratch along its shaft.
The kitchen maid was with the cook all evening: she never left the kitchen.
